sections.title: Go to Artifact of the Strong

steps.title: Enter the purple cave
steps.direction: Fly along the cave with purple crystals. Look at the stone arch ahead and go through it; Remember to keep your stamina to escape Wyvern.

steps.title: Turn into the ruins
steps.direction: Go to the end of the cave, where it seems like there is a dead end, then turn right. You will see a cluster of old stone walls.

steps.title: Get Strong
steps.direction: Through the door of the ruins. Artifact is located just behind the inner wall, not beyond the crystal clusters.

sections.title: Go to Artifact of the Devourer

steps.title: Dive into the trench
steps.direction: From the Devourer map point, dive straight into the deep trench. Use the large rock below as a landmark and continue down the crevice.

steps.title: Find glowing plants
steps.direction: Go down to the bottom to the area with glowing green trees. Don't stop too long in the middle of the ditch: this area has Tusoteuthis.

steps.title: Get Devourer
steps.direction: Find the purple glow among the green plants at the trench bottom and collect the Artifact. Keep track of the route back to the surface and watch oxygen.

steps.title: Recognize the cave entrance
steps.direction: Find the entrance under rocks and vines, next to a large tree branch. Place flyers outside the door; This part is on foot.

steps.title: Down the stone path
steps.direction: Follow the rocky path down low, continue towards the green space with light. Keep armor on you because traps can cause torpor.

steps.title: Through the green area
steps.direction: Follow the tree-covered stone floor to the orange hallway. Do not approach spiders or centipedes, even when using Cactus Broth and Bug Repellant.

steps.title: Go to the wooden branch
steps.direction: Go through the stone frame and then follow the wooden branch at the edge of the cliff. Slow down before the narrow section.

steps.title: Cross the cliff
steps.direction: Look at your feet and cling between the wooden branches to get to the shore. Have Grappling Hook ready if you fail.

steps.title: If it slips down
steps.direction: The clip includes a slip. If you fall, Grapple back onto the wooden branch; do not continue along the bottom.

steps.title: Get out of the dark
steps.direction: Go past the wooden branch and stone frame to return to the orange light. Follow the path forward.

steps.title: Go to the lava bridge
steps.direction: Go through the trees and vines, to the spot where you see the lava light. Have your weapon ready before going to the bridge.

steps.title: Cross the first bridge
steps.direction: Jump over the opening and slightly left to place your foot on the bridge. Don't rush all at once because the bridge surface is missing planks.

steps.title: Go to the other edge of the rock
steps.direction: Cross the bridge and follow the stone edge around. When you reach a large opening, stop to look at the hook point.

steps.title: Hook through the gap
steps.direction: Shoot Grapple at the ledge on the other side and pull across. Parachute can be used as backup; Falling into lava means losing your life.

steps.title: Go around the loot area
steps.direction: Climb onto the green planted platform, pass the loot area, and cross the bridge. You do not need to stop for loot during an Artifact run.

steps.title: Follow the outer circle
steps.direction: Follow bridges and stone ledges around the loot area, using the lava below as a landmark. Check gaps before jumping.

steps.title: Reach the platform behind the lava waterfall
steps.direction: Look for the lava waterfall ahead. Grapple to the stone platform behind it as shown in the clip, then release when standing securely.

steps.title: Go to Hunter
steps.direction: From this platform, look toward the blue Artifact glow. Grapple to the spot beside it; do not jump into the lava lake.

steps.title: Get Artifact
steps.direction: Stand on the stone platform and get Hunter. You don't need to fight the Lava Golem to get it; Turn back the way you just came.

sections.title: From the door below the castle → Immune

steps.title: Find the door under the castle
steps.direction: Look up at the large castle for orientation, then look for the vine-covered cave at the foot of the mountain like in the clip.

steps.title: Through the cave entrance
steps.direction: Go into the crevice with the vines. Clip using Griffin; Prepare light if you walk.

steps.title: Follow the tree-covered path
steps.direction: Follow the path between the green trees and mushrooms, going deep into the cave.

steps.title: Go to the road divider
steps.direction: Continue to the section with colorful mushrooms. Slow down to notice where the road branches.

steps.title: Go uphill and turn left
steps.direction: Go straight up the ramp ahead. When you reach the red orange mushroom, turn left, towards the green cave.

steps.title: Stick to the right wall
steps.direction: Go through the green space and stick close to the wall on the right. Don't turn into wide paths in the middle.

steps.title: Follow green mushrooms
steps.direction: Hold the right wall and go through the green mushroom and white crystal. Crawl under the low stone arch to open a wide space.

steps.title: Turn right downhill
steps.direction: When you reach a wide space, turn right and go down. There is Megalosaurus in this section; Going during the day will be easier to observe.

steps.title: Go forward then turn left
steps.direction: From the low platform, go forward, then turn left into the green space.

steps.title: Get Immune
steps.direction: Artifact glows right in this room. Get down from the animal, take Immune and then go back the same way you came.

steps.title: Find the door on the mountainside
steps.direction: Find a cave hole on the mountainside, overlooking the ocean. This door is different from the door below the castle used to reach Immune.

steps.title: Take the first left
steps.direction: Enter the cave, go straight for a while then turn left right at the red mushroom.

steps.title: Through white crystals
steps.direction: Go through clusters of white crystals. When you reach the wall covered with green mushrooms, go around to the right side of the wall.

steps.title: Turn right at the red mushroom
steps.direction: When you see the next red mushroom wall, turn right. Along the corridor there are white crystals.

steps.title: Take the left branch
steps.direction: Continue between the crystal clusters, then take the left path as shown in the clip.

steps.title: Find small holes
steps.direction: Find the small gap between the stone and the white crystal. Get off the flyer before this gap because it is difficult for large animals to get through.

steps.title: Grapple through the crevice
steps.direction: Fire Grappling Hook inward and pull yourself through the crevice. Release and hook again as needed; keep the crossbow on your hotbar.

steps.title: Go to Cunning
steps.direction: Through the gap, you will see the cave room is larger and brighter. Go to Artifact on the stone platform, then get Cunning.

steps.title: Find the ice cave door · 1/3
steps.direction: From the snowy area, find the ice door under the cliff as shown in the GIF. The outside of the clip uses Griffin; To enter the deeper dungeon, walk.

steps.title: Go through the first room and loot path · 1/3
steps.direction: Follow the ledge in the first room. The glowing loot pillars here are not Artifact; You can take it if it's safe.

steps.title: Go through the first room and loot path · 2/3
Go through the first room and loot path · 3/3
Round the bridge · 1/3
steps.direction: Go right on the bridge and then turn around to the left following the path in the GIF.

steps.title: Go to the dungeon door · 1/3
steps.direction: Drop down to the lower platform, past the loot, then take the right path to the dungeon door. Get off the animal before entering.

steps.title: Two left turns · 1/4
steps.direction: Follow the ice tunnel. At the first intersection, take the left; At the next split, also take the left side.

steps.title: Clearing Iceworms on the Road · 1/3
steps.direction: Continue down the hallway, taking care of the Iceworm blocking the way. Stop at a large platform to attack, then move forward.

steps.title: Go to the loot in the dungeon · 1/3
steps.direction: Clear nearby Iceworms and approach the loot ahead. This loot glow is not Pack yet.

steps.title: Go to the loot in the dungeon · 2/3
Go to the loot in the dungeon · 3/3
Through narrow gates with small animals · 1/3
steps.direction: Clip changed to Pyromane, animal needs separate DLC. If using this method, put the animal through the narrow door before moving to large size.

steps.title: Through narrow gates with small animals · 2/3
Through narrow gates with small animals · 3/3
Take the right side and clear the worm · 1/3
steps.direction: From the opening, go right. Clear the Iceworm that appears before moving on to the next stage.

steps.title: Take the right side and clear the worm · 2/3
Take the right side and clear the worm · 3/3
Left then right · 1/3
steps.direction: Take the left path, then turn right to the platform with loot. Grab the loot when it's safe then return to the hallway.

steps.title: Left wall attachment · 1/3
steps.direction: Grab the left wall towards the blue crystal. The clip includes a loot hole behind a cliff that can be smashed; This is a sub branch.

steps.title: Go back and get the left · 1/4
steps.direction: Exit the side loot branch, go back to the hallway and then take the left path to the next room. Clear creatures and check items before diving in.

steps.title: Go back and get the left · 2/4
Go back and get the left · 3/4
Go back and get the left · 4/4
Go straight then turn right · 1/3
steps.direction: Ignore the slope on the left, continue straight and then turn right along the corridor. This path leads towards the Iceworm Queen.

steps.title: Through the water section · 1/4
steps.direction: Go around the water space like in the GIF. The section down to the water is the loot branch; then return to the old platform to continue.

steps.title: Preparing for the Edge · 1/2
steps.direction: Go to the edge of the cliff in front of Queen's arena. Equip Parachute and check weapons, health, and medicine before going down.

steps.title: Descent through invisible barrier · 1/2
steps.direction: Use Parachute to land on the platform shown in the GIF. Keep Pyromane small until past the invisible barrier; enlarging too early can get it stuck on the edge.

steps.title: Beat the Iceworm Queen
steps.direction: Defeat Queen before searching for Pack. The clip uses Pyromane and circles Queen; choose gear, tame, and weapons from the cave's Boss section.

steps.title: End of Queen's battle
steps.direction: Defeat the Queen, process the reward, then check your health and stamina. Only continue when the arena is safe.

steps.title: Left path to Pack · 1/2
steps.direction: From the arena entrance, go left through the tunnel toward Pack. This section demonstrates the route in Creative; in your own run, defeat Queen before collecting the Artifact.

steps.title: Recognize the entrance ruins
steps.direction: Find the ruins at the cave entrance GPS above. Crouch or crawl through the low entrance; bring a shoulder pet for the sacrifice before entering the button room.

steps.title: Press D R A K above · 1/2
steps.direction: In the first room, press the letters in order D → R → A → K → K → A → R. The first four letters are in the upper area as shown in the GIF.

steps.title: Press D R A K above · 2/2
Press K A R below · 1/2
steps.direction: Find the final three letters in the lower area. R is behind the door; its opening button is behind barrels in the room marked U. Avoid floor traps.

steps.title: Cross the lake and enter the statue room · 1/3
steps.direction: After opening the path, go through the lake and follow the hallway to the statue room. Going deeper through the lake means you have to complete the dungeon to get out.

steps.title: Cross the lake and enter the statue room · 2/3
Cross the lake and enter the statue room · 3/3
Crouch and press the left button · 1/2
steps.direction: Keep low in the statue room; If you stand up, you can die immediately. Press the left button first, don't step on the small mounds on the floor.

steps.title: Crouch and press the left button · 2/2
Loop to the right button · 1/2
steps.direction: Still crouching, follow the edge of the room to the button on the right. Don't take shortcuts through the middle of the statue.

steps.title: Crawl under the hand and press the middle button · 1/2
steps.direction: Lie down and crawl under the statue's hand to the middle button. The order of the room is left → right → middle. The right door leads to Clever, the left door leads to Skylord; Both branches go to the sacrificial room.

steps.title: Crawl under the hand and press the middle button · 2/2
Enter the right branch through the water room · 1/3
steps.direction: Choose the right door in the statue room. Cross the water and stone platforms; prepare for Piranha if you fall into the water.

steps.title: Enter the right branch through the water room · 2/3
Enter the right branch through the water room · 3/3
Go through the narrow passage and press the button · 1/3
steps.direction: Follow the ledge to the switch in the wall and then through the opening. Look at the landing platforms in the GIF before jumping.

steps.title: Go through the narrow passage and press the button · 2/3
Go through the narrow passage and press the button · 3/3
Avoid the middle of the red statue room · 1/3
steps.direction: Clear spawned creatures before descending. Avoid the steps and central area between red statues; pressure plates may summon creatures or trigger instant-death traps.

steps.title: Avoid the middle of the red statue room · 2/3
Avoid the middle of the red statue room · 3/3
Press the buttons around the wall · 1/4
steps.direction: Go around the wall and press the buttons like in the GIF. Clip tries one round then continues the second round; If the door is not open, recheck each button and avoid the middle of the room.

steps.title: Press the buttons around the wall · 2/4
Press the buttons around the wall · 3/4
Press the buttons around the wall · 4/4
Find your way to the pair of timing buttons · 1/3
steps.direction: From the right door, follow the hallway past the middle button to the pair of buttons next to the door. Check out all the maze running GIFs behind before starting.

steps.title: Find your way to the pair of timing buttons · 2/3
Find your way to the pair of timing buttons · 3/3
Press the two buttons next to the door
steps.direction: Press both buttons on either side of the door. The clock starts when the right button is pressed; You have about a minute to get to the last door.

steps.title: Run the first part of the maze · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow each turn in the GIF, crouch through low doors. Don't stop to pick up loot during the timed run.

steps.title: Run the first part of the maze · 2/2
Run to the last door · 1/3
steps.direction: Continue through the corridors and clear blocking creatures. Follow the images carefully because many chambers look similar.

steps.title: Go through the door and get Clever · 1/2
steps.direction: Go through the door before it closes, go down to the green lighted space and get Clever. If late, return to the first pair of buttons to open and run again.

steps.title: Go through the door and get Clever · 2/2
Go to the sacrifice room · 1/2
steps.direction: Continue from Clever through the corridor to the sacrificial pedestal room. Follow the Sacrifice & final two Artifacts section below to exit.

steps.title: Choose the left door and enter the water · 1/2
steps.direction: From the common statue room, choose the left door. Crawl through the low path and prepare SCUBA, flippers before the swimming section.

steps.title: Choose the left door and enter the water · 2/2
Swim through the tunnel · 1/3
steps.direction: Swim down the tunnel under the rock to the room with the buttons in the middle. There are sharks; Maintain enough oxygen and stamina.

steps.title: Open the door to the first room · 1/2
steps.direction: Press the buttons in the middle to open the branch doors, then follow the order shown in the GIF. Creatures may appear when the door is open.

steps.title: Open the door to the first room · 2/2
Click the first room branches · 1/2
steps.direction: Follow each branch to press the button, return to the middle of the room and go through the opened door. Don't change branches just because the door is open.

steps.title: Second room: front left · 1/3
steps.direction: In the next room, press the middle button again to open the doors. Follow the left branch near the front door, handle the animal and press the button.

steps.title: Through the remaining branches · 1/3
steps.direction: Return to the middle of the room, continue to the remaining branches along the GIF path. Each time you open a branch, be prepared to handle the critters.

steps.title: Open the door at the end of the room · 1/3
steps.direction: After the branch buttons, go to the far path and open the last door switch. Follow the hallway to the gray stone room.

steps.title: Open the door at the end of the room · 2/3
Open the door at the end of the room · 3/3
Go to the hole into the lake · 1/3
steps.direction: Go through the gray stone room and find the floor hole under the stone steps. Prepare weapons before going down; There is Spino under the lake.

steps.title: Go to the hole into the lake · 2/3
Go to the hole into the lake · 3/3
Board the boat to fight Spino · 1/3
steps.direction: After entering the lake, swim to the boat to get a position to hit Spino. Clear out creatures before diving for the button.

steps.title: Board the boat to fight Spino · 2/3
Board the boat to fight Spino · 3/3
Press the underwater button · 1/3
steps.direction: Dive around the statues and press the button clockwise. If the door is not open, check and do another round like the clip.

steps.title: Climb back upstairs · 1/4
steps.direction: Follow the ledges and steps to the upper level. Go slowly in open areas, checking each landing platform.

steps.title: Press the button to open the parkour path · 1/2
steps.direction: Pass through the door to the pillar-jump area. Press the wall button to open a timed door; preview the next GIFs to learn the route.

steps.title: Press the button to open the parkour path · 2/2
Go to the first dance room · 1/3
steps.direction: Jump each narrow platform and ledge like in the GIF. If you fall, you die and you can't get your items back; Don't try to jump until you see the landing platform.

steps.title: Go to the first dance room · 2/3
Go to the first dance room · 3/3
Over to the next dance room · 1/3
steps.direction: Continue through the doorway and narrow stone platforms. Follow each GIF section and keep enough stamina for long jumps.

steps.title: Over to the next dance room · 2/3
Over to the next dance room · 3/3
Get Skylord · 1/2
steps.direction: Go through the last platform to alcove Artifact and get Skylord. The path then leads back to the same sacrificial chamber as branch Clever.

steps.title: Return to the sacrifice room
steps.direction: Follow the hallway from alcove Skylord to the room with the sacrificial platform. You need to complete the bottom part to get out.

steps.title: Shoulder animal sacrifice · 1/2
steps.direction: Single player: bring a shoulder pet to sacrifice on the pedestal shown in the GIF. This route lets you continue; the human-sacrifice branch needs another player.

steps.title: Through the dark hallway · 1/2
steps.direction: After opening the door, follow the dark corridor with traps and bats. Use a torch to see the floor and avoid trap tiles.

steps.title: Go to the arena · 1/4
steps.direction: Cross the bridge and steps of the ruins to the area with the tree and Megaloceros. Check shotguns, bullets and medicine before engaging in battle.

sections.title: Defeat the soul beast & get the last two Artifact

steps.title: Attack and clear each wave · 1/2
steps.direction: Kill Megaloceros to trigger Spirit Direwolf and Direbear waves. Clear every wave before looking for the Artifact route.

steps.title: Clear the arena · 1/2
steps.direction: Continue clearing Spirit creatures. Wait for the completion notification before crossing the newly opened barrier.

steps.title: Get Devious and Massive
steps.direction: After the barrier opens, enter the Artifact chamber and collect both Devious and Massive. Check your inventory before leaving.

steps.title: Follow the water out
steps.direction: Follow the water passage and low exit as shown in the GIF. The cave run is complete once you have brought the Artifacts out safely.
